name: shahdara-team
summary: ONE orchestrator for OfferPk/shahdara-isp-billing. TEAM MODE since 2026-10-19 (John): 4 agents one at a time, sequential agent1 (Dashboard & Reports) -> agent2 (Mobile & Navigation) -> agent3 (Forms, Field Tools & Settings) -> agent4 (QA & Polish), each in a strict file-ownership LANE (LANES.md; cross-lane changes via lane:agentN / lane:grok issues; rebase on main before PR). grok-review issues first within the lane, REA rule, 7-step workflow, 20-min minimum until merged, quota rule (never rotate accounts). Solo copies in solo-mode-20261018/, old 6-slot team copies in team-mode-6slot-20261017/. 2026-10-19: quota-aware gate + budget mode + efficiency rules; Grok reviews only, former Grok-owned files moved to agent4 lane. 2026-10-19 21:55: agent5 Easypaisa Email Reader (issue #305, lane:agent5) added; gets every other budget run until agent5\DONE.txt.
source: Copy of sidecars\shahdara-team\sidecar.json + shahdara-project\TEAM.md, TEAM_PROMPT.txt, LANES.md, team-gate.ps1, AGENTS.md, agentN\TASK.md from John's PC (updated 2026-10-19: team mode with lanes).
schedule: CRON_TZ=Asia/Karachi every 5 min: team-gate.ps1 starts a new conversation ONLY if TEAM.lock is missing or older than 90 min (heartbeat after every step). QUOTA-AWARE (2026-10-19): after a 429 run the gate writes QUOTA_WAIT.txt and retries once per hour. BUDGET MODE until 2026-10-21 12:30 PKT (BUDGET.json): max 4 runs/day, 240 min gap, one 45-min turn per run, order agent1>agent3>agent2>agent4(every other cycle), agent4 on flash_lite; auto-expires.
notes: Recommended Shahdara setup (sequential). Replaces the 3 parallel agents: never run it together with them or with shahdara-ui.
Gate log: shahdara-project\team-gate.log. To restart a stuck cycle at once: delete shahdara-project\TEAM.lock.

agent4 (shahdara-polish-qa) keeps agent4\FEATURE_AUDIT.md (Works/Broken/Ugly per button) and adds Playwright e2e tests (tests/e2e/*.spec.mjs) + a CI e2e job. Covered by the existing sidecar grants (command(npx), command(npm), command(node), write_file on shahdara-project); no sidecar change needed.

grok-review: Grok files GitHub issues labeled grok-review every 2 h; agent4 lists them at the start of every turn (GitHub MCP list_issues/search_issues, already granted), fixes them first and closes them via 'Fixes #N'.

Turn order (team, since 2026-10-19): slot1 agent1 -> slot2 agent2 -> slot3 agent3 -> slot4 agent4 -> slot1; NEXT_AGENT.txt = '<slot> <agent>' (start '1 agent1'). After 4 turns the run deletes TEAM.lock and ends; the gate starts a fresh conversation within 5 min.

LANES.md: strict file ownership per agent (agent1 Dashboard & Reports, agent2 Mobile & Navigation, agent3 Forms / Field Tools / Settings, agent4 QA & Polish with no feature files, plus Grok-owned customer/payment/Quick+Bulk Collect/toast/screen-router modules). Cross-lane changes go through GitHub issues labeled lane:agent1..4 / lane:grok (labels exist in OfferPk/shahdara-isp-billing).
Quota: on 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED the run saves state and deletes TEAM.lock; never rotate accounts. All agents share one Antigravity quota.
Switch to solo mode again: copy solo-mode-20261018/* over the PC files and set NEXT_AGENT.txt to '2 agent4'. Old 6-slot team files: team-mode-6slot-20261017/.
